avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer significantly reduces atazanavir levels below therapeutic range, reducing viral suppression
avoid_supplements.action: Absolutely contraindicated; discontinue or avoid all St. John's Wort products

avoid_supplements.name: Rifampin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducer dramatically reduces atazanavir plasma concentrations
avoid_supplements.action: Do not co-administer; use alternative antimicrobial agent

avoid_supplements.name: Proton Pump Inhibitors (omeprazole, lansoprazole)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Increases gastric pH, reducing atazanavir solubility and absorption by 75-94%
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use H2-antagonist alternative if acid suppression needed; separate dosing by 12+ hours

caution_supplements.name: Calcium/Magnesium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May reduce atazanavir absorption through chelation and pH elevation; effect modest with separation
caution_supplements.action: Separate administration by 2+ hours from atazanavir; monitor viral load

caution_supplements.name: Iron supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May chelate atazanavir and reduce absorption
caution_supplements.action: Space dosing 2+ hours apart; monitor clinical response

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals with certain preparations
avoid_foods.mechanism: Atazanavir absorption is pH-dependent and reduced with significant food; fat content may variably affect bioavailability
avoid_foods.action: Take atazanavir with food (light snack preferred); avoid heavy/high-fat meals for optimal absorption

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor may increase atazanavir levels and prolong QT interval risk
caution_foods.action: Limit consumption; monitor QTc if regular intake continues

caution_foods.name: Garlic supplements (high-dose)
caution_foods.mechanism: May induce CYP3A4 at high doses, potentially reducing atazanavir levels
caution_foods.action: Use culinary amounts only; avoid high-dose therapeutic garlic products

monitoring_notes: Atazanavir requires acidic gastric environment for optimal absorption; monitor for virologic failure if gastric pH is elevated. Regular assessment of CD4 count, HIV RNA, and QTc interval (especially with concurrent QT-prolonging agents) is essential given atazanavir's cardiac conduction effects.
